metric: Arithmetic mean across all detected D0 slips for each mouse, pooled across retained trials; includes stop overlaps and positions outside tape. No event or mouse clipping.
units: Detector area units: sum(max(MovementTrace-2.5,0)), no division by frame rate; not physical displacement
layout: Circles: mice. Diamonds: arithmetic means of mouse means within cages. Bars: arithmetic means of mouse means within groups. Cohort included in cage identity.
aggregation: Each event equally weighted within mouse; each mouse equally weighted in cage and group summaries. No-slip mice would need separate handling; all 42 D0 mice have events.
